The current root TOML schema is **31**. Discovery is `--config` → trusted `./heycode.toml` → absolute `$HEYCODE_HOME/config.toml` → built-in defaults. A relative `HEYCODE_HOME`, unknown field/path, malformed type, or newer schema fails loud.

## Root `heycode.toml`

| Path | Type | Default | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profile.plugins` | array of strings | empty | Ordered plugin factory names. |
| `llm.provider` | string | `deepseek` | Provider factory name (`deepseek`, `openrouter`, …). |
| `llm.model` | string | `deepseek-v4-flash` | Model id passed through to the provider. |
| `llm.base_url` | string or omitted | omitted | Optional base-url override (proxies, gateways). |
| `llm.api_key_env` | string or omitted | omitted | Optional API-key env var override. |
| `llm.protocol` | `LlmProtocolCfg` | `LlmProtocolCfg::Auto` | Exact provider wire dialect when more than one reviewed adapter exists. |
| `llm.max_output_tokens` | `Option<u64>` | omitted | Optional explicit provider-owned output-token default. |
| `tools.terminals_enabled` | boolean | `false` | Register the E07 persistent-terminal tools. Off by default: a terminal holds a live process for the life of the session, so it is opt-in. |
| `tools.execution_retained_bytes` | integer | `256 * 1024` | Bytes retained per execution stdout/stderr/terminal stream (1 KiB..=1 MiB). |
| `tools.execution_inline_bytes` | integer | `6 * 1024` | Inline output body cap (1 KiB..=32 KiB); larger output is paged with job_output. |
| `tools.execution_history_limit` | integer | `64` | Number of execution output histories retained in this session (1..=256). |
| `tools.foreground_timeout_secs` | integer | `120` | Seconds before an eligible foreground tool is promoted; zero disables it. |
| `tools.bash_timeout_ms` | integer | `600000` | Bash timeout in milliseconds. |
| `tools.read_max_bytes` | integer | `262144` | Max bytes per `read`. |
| `tools.read_max_lines` | integer | `2000` | Max lines per `read`. |
| `ui.accent` | string or omitted | omitted | Accent color as `#RRGGBB`; defaults to the Claude-orange token. |
| `ui.auto_title` | boolean | `false` | Generate a session title after the first turn (opt-in; costs one provider call). |
| `approval.mode` | `Option<ApprovalMode>` | omitted | `full_access` asks no permission; `accepted_edits` remembers each approved action for the conversation; `ask` (alias `default`) asks every time. `auto` requires AI classification and is unavailable without it. `deny` remains a non-menu compatibility control. Unset: interactive `ask`, headless `full_access`. |
| `compaction.auto` | boolean | `true` | Fold automatically when projected context crosses the threshold. |
| `compaction.threshold_ratio` | number | `0.8` | Fraction of [`Self::context_window`] that triggers folding. |
| `compaction.context_window` | integer | `0` | Explicit context cap/fallback in tokens; zero uses the active model limit. |
| `subagent.max_depth` | integer | `3` | Maximum nesting depth of `task` calls (1 = flat children only). |
| `subagent.worktree_base` | string or omitted | omitted | Exact full Git commit used by optional isolated worktree providers. |
| `subagent.max_concurrent` | integer | `0` | Shared native descendant inference concurrency; zero means unlimited. |
| `subagent.max_provider_requests` | integer | `0` | Session-lifetime inference dispatch limit; zero means unlimited. |
| `subagent.max_output_tokens` | integer | `0` | Optional descendant output-token cap; zero uses provider/model defaults. |
| `jobs.max_concurrent` | integer | `8` | Concurrent process operations; coordinators use separately bounded inference. |
| `jobs.max_queued` | integer | `64` | Waiting/coordination row ceiling beyond the running capacity. |
| `jobs.max_history` | integer | `256` | Retained settled summaries (active handles are never silently pruned). |
| `jobs.max_admissions` | integer | `0` | Session-lifetime job admission cap; zero means unlimited. |
| `sandbox.mode` | `off | readonly | workspace` | `off` | `off` (default) | `readonly` | `workspace`. |
| `web.enabled` | boolean | `true` | Register `web_fetch` / `web_search`. Search works keyless via DuckDuckGo Lite; set `BRAVE_API_KEY` to upgrade result quality. |
| `mcp.servers.<name>` | map of server tables | empty | Each name selects exactly one stdio or Streamable HTTP transport. |

`[profile].plugins` is an exact ordered override. Leave it absent or empty to track the built-in profile; a frozen list does not gain future plugins automatically.

## MCP server table

Under `[mcp.servers.<name>]`, choose exactly one of `command` and `url`. `args` and `env` are valid only with `command`.

| Key | Type | Default | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | string or omitted | omitted | Executable to spawn (resolved via PATH). Selects the stdio transport. |
| `url` | string or omitted | omitted | Streamable HTTP endpoint. Selects the HTTP transport. |
| `args` | array of strings | empty | Argument vector. Stdio only. |
| `env` | map of strings | empty | Extra environment for the child. Stdio only. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | Whether a failure to connect this server fails the whole session.  Off by default: a mistyped command or a binary that is not installed yet shows as a failed server in `/mcp` and heycode still starts. Set it when the session is meaningless without the server. |

## Named profiles

The current standalone profile schema is **3** at `$HEYCODE_HOME/profiles/<name>.toml`. Profiles contain ordered `[[plugins]]` rows with `id` and `enabled`; schema v2 also permits managed-only constraints. `--profile <name>` and `/profile` share the same strict store.

Credential values never belong in root config, profiles, Settings, generated references, or examples. These surfaces retain non-secret references only.
